name: Local web animation
description: LocalWebAnimation(html:) renders bundled CSS animation with JavaScript disabled, a nonpersistent store and restrictive CSP.
usage: LocalWebAnimation(html:) renders bundled CSS animation with JavaScript disabled, a nonpersistent store and restrictive CSP. No remote pages, tracking or message bridges. Provide accessible native equivalent content. Reduce Motion disables CSS animation. This is a local animation module, not a general web browser.
statusNote: Built into a minimal app with Xcode 27.0 (27A266a) on 2026-10-09.
